title: Electronic Security Systems Supervisor
desc:
We are looking for an
Electronic Security Systems Supervisor
to join Anadolu Group's Operational Resilience and Crisis Management Team.
Job Description:
Manage, develop and standardize CCTV/VMS, access control, alarm, perimeter security, license plate recognition and visitor management systems across Group companies and facilities,
Coordinate the full project lifecycle for new facilities and renovations, from site survey to commissioning,
Contribute to technical specifications, vendor proposal evaluations and budget planning,
Monitor the performance of contractors and integrators against SLAs and contract terms,
Evaluate emerging technologies such as video analytics, AI, biometrics and IoT, and lead pilot implementations,
Take an active role in physical security risk assessments, audits and incident analyses,
Support IT teams in ensuring security data is managed in line with KVKK (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law) and information security principles.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical-Electronics, Electronics and Communications, Computer, Control and Automation, Mechatronics Engineering or a related field,
Minimum 4 years of experience in electronic security systems and physical security,
Strong technical knowledge of CCTV/VMS, IP cameras, access control and alarm systems; solid understanding of network, server and storage infrastructure,
Experience in project, vendor and maintenance management,
Ability to read technical drawings and system architectures,
Proficiency in English and MS Office applications,
Analytical mindset, ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, strong communication skills,
Based in Istanbul, with no travel restrictions
As Anadolu Group, we care about your Personal Data Security. Please find the Personal Data Protection Information Notice from the link below.
